meta.title: Two bids: award a split: 6 units to B and 4 units to A; approver approves with a remark
gaps: The prepared state contains exactly one bid, so a second closed vendor bid with Vendor B at 90 and Vendor A at 100 cannot be established.
Allocate exact quantities of 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A, including validating totals of 540, 400, and 940.
Fill and submit the proposal with the required fields.
Sign in as the approver, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve the proposal.
Verify one purchase order per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state contains exactly one bid, so a second closed vendor bid with Vendor B at 90 and Vendor A at 100 cannot be established.; Allocate exact quantities of 6 units to Vendor B and 4 units to Vendor A, including validating totals of 540, 400, and 940.; Fill and submit the proposal with the required fields.; Sign in as the approver, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve the proposal.; Verify one purchase order per awarded vendor and that the event moves to History.

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ's Master QCS; the event already exists and must not be recreated.
Reach the awarding screen, which is the closest available navigation for the requested split allocation.

args.need: provide a closed RFQ with two vendor bids, perform the 6-unit/4-unit split allocation, submit the proposal, and approve it as the assigned approver with the remark "OK — QA"

steps.note: The catalog cannot create the required two-bid closed state, enter quantity splits, submit the proposal, or use another approver's session.
If the tester completed the requested split allocation, verify that the awarding screen reports the line selected and two awarded vendors.
